name: Vernier Metal Fabricating Inc
old_description: Vernier Metal Fabricating Inc. is recognized regionally as an industry leader in precision sheet metal manufacturing. We supply prototypes, production components, and assemblies to a diverse range of customers. With over 50 years experience servicing those diverse customers, we are confident we will exceed your expectations.  Our modern facility is located in Seymour, Connecticut.
about:
Vernier Metal Fabricating Inc. was founded in 1964 in Seymour, Connecticut, as a two-person sheet metal shop. Over more than five decades, the business has grown into a large, well-equipped facility with a highly skilled workforce, while remaining family-owned and operated.

The company specializes in precision sheet metal fabrication and structural weldments, offering services from design and prototyping to full-scale production. Its 12-acre campus houses automated equipment, robotics, and dedicated departments for each manufacturing stage, enabling runs from single prototypes to high-volume orders.

Vernier Metal serves a diverse customer base across multiple industries, supplying prototypes, production components, and assemblies. The company does not publicly list specific industry sectors.

The company emphasizes quality and invests in advanced technology and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and consistency. It tailors its processes to each customer’s requirements rather than offering a one-size-fits-all approach.
